    • escapeXml

      public static String escapeXml(String value)
      Escapes the five predefined XML entities (& < > " ') in the supplied string so it can be safely embedded as XML element text or as a single- or double-quoted attribute value.

      This is intended for the rare cases where XML is assembled by hand; prefer building XML through a DOM/XMLStreamWriter where practical.

      Parameters:
      value - the string to escape, may be null
      Returns:
      the escaped string, or null if value was null
      Since:
      POI 6.0.0
